title: Geometric objects detect containment of open curve substacks
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field] and C the category of proper algebraic-space curve families [def-sfb-proper-curve-moduli]. Let U,V be full open substacks of C [def-sfb-open-moduli-substack]. If every object X of V over Spec Omega, for each algebraically closed field Omega and map Spec Omega -> Spec k [def-weil-algebraic-closure], belongs to U, then V is contained in U, meaning membership implication on all objects over all k-schemes.

source.place: Lemma lemma-open-substacks (Tag 06FJ), scheme-pullback proof of inclusion detection

proof.text: For an object Y of V over T, form its fibred Yoneda functor using cartesian lifts. The definition of the open U represents its two-pullback by an open immersion W -> T. Membership of any pullback object in U is equivalent to lifting its classifying functor into this open: evaluate a factorization at the identity object; conversely use closure of U under all arrows.

source.place: Lemma lemma-open-substacks (Tag 06FJ), scheme-pullback proof of inclusion detection

proof.text: Every point t of T has a geometric lift from the spectrum of an algebraic closure of its residue field. The pullback object of Y lies in V by stability under arrows, hence in U by assumption. Thus this geometric point lifts to W and t lies in the image of W. The open immersion W -> T is surjective, hence an isomorphism. Evaluation at the identity object of T then puts Y in U. This argument applies also when T is empty.
